'''LEP-96M3''' was the personal [[LEP servant droid/Legends|LEP servant droid]] of [[General/Legends|General]] [[Whorm Loathsom/Legends|Whorm Loathsom]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. It had a high voice and spoke in an odd language, consisting of changing high and lower pitch. Its "ears" were used at one point to hold a hologram transmission projector for Loathsom when receiving a progress report from a [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]].

==Biography==
[[File:Bunnydroid_holds_holo.png|thumb|left|200px|Loathsom's assistant droid holding an [[Imagecaster/Legends|imagecaster]] between his "ears".]]
LEP-96M3 was working for Loathsom during the [[Battle of Christophsis/Legends|Battle of Christophsis]]. When the battle reached a high point for the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], General [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Kenobi]] appeared to surrender to Loathsom. Loathsom had his droid serve [[Tarine tea/Legends|Tarine tea]] for Kenobi and him while they discussed the terms of surrender. However, [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], and his new apprentice, [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], destroyed the Confederacy's shield generator, and Kenobi turned the tables on Loathsom. It was destroyed by a [[B2-series super battle droid/Legends|super battle droid]] attempting to fire at General Kenobi.
